title: Gas Stations Don't Make Money Selling You Gas. Here's What Actually Pays.
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

A gallon of gas often earns a station just a few cents in profit after costs, sometimes less on a bad week. The real money is inside: coffee, snacks, drinks, lottery tickets, car washes and loyalty apps can carry profit margins many times higher than fuel. The pumps get drivers in the door; the convenience store is where the business actually makes its money. Educational content only, not financial advice.
